notes: The clock offers five arrangements instead of one: Tracked spreads the day wide and thin over a quiet line, Beside sets it against a hairline divider with the time and date stacked, Ghost leaves it barely there behind the reading, Murmur…
You choose which of the three facts leads on each card - the day, the time or the date - and the same arrangement reads as a clock, a calendar or a day board depending on it.

Every arrangement adapts to the card it is given by using a shorter wording rather than smaller type: a wide card reads "Thursday, 3 September 2026" and a narrow one "Thu, 3 Sep", and nothing ever drops below the size this theme will still…
The layout maker shows your actual desktop wallpaper behind the strip, so a reading is judged where it will really sit instead of against a flat background.
Saved layouts have a Use button: one click puts the layout on every panel running Mirage, without leaving the maker to find it in Panel Settings.
